title: US Code /us/usc/t31/s3716/a — fresh checker study

uslm_source.xml:
<ns0:uscDoc xmlns:ns0="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0 USLM-1.0.15.xsd" xml:lang="en" identifier="/us/usc/t31"><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="idbd3cda73-47c4-11f1-bea6-82cea744851c" identifier="/us/usc/t31/s3716/a"><ns0:num value="a">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> After trying to collect a claim from a person under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t31/s3711/a">section 3711(a) of this title</ns0:ref>, the head of an executive, judicial, or legislative agency may collect the claim by administrative offset. The head of the agency may collect by administrative offset only after giving the debtor—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="idbd3cda74-47c4-11f1-bea6-82cea744851c" identifier="/us/usc/t31/s3716/a/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> written notice of the type and amount of the claim, the intention of the head of the agency to collect the claim by administrative offset, and an explanation of the rights of the debtor under this section;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="idbd3cda75-47c4-11f1-bea6-82cea744851c" identifier="/us/usc/t31/s3716/a/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an opportunity to inspect and copy the records of the agency related to the claim;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="idbd3cda76-47c4-11f1-bea6-82cea744851c" identifier="/us/usc/t31/s3716/a/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an opportunity for a review within the agency of the decision of the agency related to the claim; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="idbd3cda77-47c4-11f1-bea6-82cea744851c" identifier="/us/usc/t31/s3716/a/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an opportunity to make a written agreement with the head of the agency to repay the amount of the claim.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
</ns0:uscDoc>
